bookingOpens: Online through TableCheck for up to six guests, with a card guarantee. Phone lines are open Monday to Saturday; calls after 6pm may not be answered.
cancellation: Cancel or change at least 48 hours ahead. Later cancellations and no-shows are charged S$100 a guest.
groups: Parties of more than six book through WhatsApp on +65 9456 3147. Three private rooms seat up to 14.
dressCode: Smart casual. Flip-flops and slippers are discouraged.
duration: About two and a half hours for dinner.
byob: Corkage is S$90++ a 750ml bottle, or free one for one with a bottle bought from the wine list.
